Text: Giving an AI access to your machine is useful—but stitching together terminal, file, and process tools is tedious.

Desktop Commander MCP is a TypeScript MCP server for builders who want an MCP-compatible AI client to work with their computer.

It helps you automate local development tasks by exposing tools for filesystem operations, terminal commands, code editing, search, and process control.

Key features:
• Terminal control – run commands, stream output, and manage long-running sessions
• File operations – read, write, move, list, and search local files
• Surgical editing – apply targeted or pattern-based text replacements
• Data and document support – work with Excel, PDF, DOCX, CSV, and JSON files
• Configurable guardrails – log tool calls, block commands, limit file-operation paths, or use Docker isolation

It’s open-source (MIT license).
